title: SOC2 daily scratchpad - evidence & vendor notes
content:
Quick morning scratchpad - SOC2 evidence tasks

TODAY (2026-03-04) - priorities:
- [ ] Finalize IAM role evidence package for Dedicated infra (need confirm from infra on latest role json). Jira: SOC2-2345.
- [ ] Vendor review: SecureVault (storage encryption provider) - outstanding: A. SOC2 report (latest), B. contracts redline status, C. encryption in transit proof (TLS config). Assigned to Liam to follow up.
- [ ] Collect KMS key rotation logs (last rotation: 2025-11-10) — ask infra to export cloudtrail->s3 slice. Linked artifact above.
- [ ] Update confluence table with new evidence links and expiration dates (cols: artifact, owner, storage path, retention, last verified).
- [ ] Merge docs PR for evidence collection automation (PR #876) once Evelyn confirms mapping for S3 prefixes.

Notes / fragments:
- IAM evidence: we have role ARNs but need time-stamped policy attachments. Might be easiest to request infra to pull audit-history snapshot (cloudtrail) and sign-off.
- SecureVault: review checklist: encrypt-at-rest method (AES-256?), access controls (SCIM/group sync), multi-region replication (is replication encrypted?), subprocessor list. Need SOC report (last 12 months).
- Third-party risk: add vendor to vendor-register spreadsheet with risk rating (low/med/high) + next review date. Link to sheet: /shared_drives/security_and_compliance/vendor-register (TODO: copy link).
- Evidence expiration reminder: some certs expire 2026-04-15 — add calendar reminder and owner.

Open questions / blockers:
- Who owns the customer-data S3 bucket lifecycle policy? (Pinged @infra on Slack yesterday, no reply).
- Does SecureVault support per-tenant keys or only single master key? Impacts scope of encryption evidence.

Quick timeline for this week:
- Thu 3/5: internal pre-audit sync (30m) — prepare checklist + highlight missing artifacts.
- Fri 3/6: send vendor evidence request template to SecureVault legal + sales. Include SSO/SCIM screenshots request.

Action items (assign):
- Priya: compile evidence index (this doc -> confluence table) and mark missing items.
- Liam: follow up SecureVault (SOC report + contract status) — due 3/6.
- Evelyn: confirm PR mapping for automated evidence uploads -> s3 prefixes.
- Infra (cc: @Noah Martinez): export KMS rotation logs and policy attachment snapshots.

Random notes to self:
- Keep evidence naming consistent: svcname_evidence_YYYYMMDD.pdf or .json
- Consider adding a short readme in the evidence bucket to explain provenance and retention.
- If we get SecureVault SOC2 report, redact PII then attach to confluence as restricted doc.

Meeting notes (2/27 sync):
- Decided to prefer cloudtrail snapshots for attestation instead of manual screenshots — reduces reviewer work.
- Need to scope evidence sampling strategy (full vs sampled) for Dedicated customers.

Short-term TODO list (non-blocking):
- [ ] Draft vendor evidence request template (copy from prior template in confluence).
- [ ] Add calendar reminders for expiring certs.
- [ ] Check retention policy for compliance snapshots (90 days vs 1 year).
- [ ] Validate access list for evidence bucket (who has read/write).

If I get stuck: ping legal for contract redline priorities, or ask SRE for quick export CMDs.

---
Last quick log: 2026-03-03 17:22 — pulled initial list of evidence items, flagged 8 missing artifacts. Will iterate tomorrow.
